proposed_next_capability.ability: Conditional local direct-carbonation operator with explicit macroscopic mobility input and independent stoichiometric/extent contract
proposed_next_capability.why: P36 proves a specific exact-donor pathway gap. First principles determine stoichiometry/shared affinity/dissipation, while reviewed sources do not identify bulk mobility. A supplied-input local operator can be implemented without inventing default brickA/E; whole-host activation remains separately unqualified.
proposed_next_capability.input_contract: Positive macroscopic mobility with1/s units, source/material/temperature/humidity/surface applicability and value supplied explicitly. No hidden/defaultA/E or direct rate inferred from nm/s, atomisticEa or finalDoC. Synthetic positive unit-mobility fixture is diagnostic only, not a nominal brick parameter.
proposed_next_capability.suggested_law_status: Assumed affinity/donor phenomenology, not a literature rate law; source admitted mechanism only. Selected law and gas activities must be specified before implementation.
proposed_next_capability.shared_coupling: nu_d=nu_h-nu_c, common fullmu/U/S/volume; dn_calcite=+r_d,dn_OH=-r_d; independent extent derivative+r_d, OH+xi_h+xi_d invariant. Gas source and heat counted once.
proposed_next_capability.reuse: Use already saved P36 mu/T/partial and donor cases; do not recompute these four host states or repeat old rates. Evaluate only new local operator under declared positive synthetic input.
proposed_next_capability.qualification_boundary: Positive-input local closure/dissipation is not disabled-channel dynamic acceptance. This first item cannot claim full-cycle direct-path implementation, macro speed or new original/extended gates. Any host activation/extra extent changes require separate registered affected verification budget before integration.
proposed_next_capability.alternative_real_gap: Current inverse TG is total mass/initial_dry, not source-specific OH-loss versus carbonate-gain DoC. Source-only paired TG mapping is implementable after exactEq5/6 images are read; no guess of denominator or automatic backgroundcalcite->purepowder mapping.

candidate_local_law.definition: A=delta_mu_direct/(R*T); a_i=p_i/P_ref. IfA<=0, r_d=L*n_portlandite*a_CO2*(1-exp(A)); ifA>0, r_d=-L*n_calcite*a_H2O*(1-exp(-A)).
candidate_local_law.units: L explicitly supplied in1/s; n in mol; a/A dimensionless; r in mol/s.
candidate_local_law.physical_domain: Finite positiveT/partial pressures and nonnegative solid donors. PositiveL gives -r_d*delta_mu_direct/T>=0 and both branches vanish atA=0. This proves sign/unit/stoichiometry only, not macro kinetics.
candidate_local_law.mobility_identity: No default value or brickA/E. Positive synthetic unitL would be a local fixture only, source/assumed identity explicit. Actual material/time/humidity/surface mobility remains supplied and unqualified until evidenced.
candidate_local_law.double_counting: Independent kinetic pathway adds one rate@nu and one extent; same existing speciesU/S/volume, no separate reaction heat. Stoichiometric dependence is not duplicate source counting if every rate is accounted once.
